mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS announcement_id, a.title, a.content_html, a.force_confirm, a.published_at FROM system_announcement_recipient r INNER JOIN system_announcement a ON a.id = r.announcement_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.delivery_status = 'PENDING' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE system_announcement_recipient SET delivery_status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND delivery_status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE system_announcement_recipient SET delivery_status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND delivery_status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO system_announcement_recipient (announcement_id, user_id, user_name_snapshot, username_snapshot, role_snapshot, delivery_status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted) VALUES
(#{item.announcementId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.userNameSnapshot}, #{item.usernameSnapshot}, #{item.roleSnapshot}, #{item.deliveryStatus}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.isDeleted})
